representation.prompts: Native HTML and KaTeX for every prompt with original wording, part labels, marks, bold emphasis, question-specific instructions and faithful vector figure crops. As in the earlier imports, printed captions such as "Figure 1" sit outside the crop; the alt text of each figure names it.
representation.solutions: Every question-specific mark-scheme page as ordered vector crops: working, marks, AOs, alternatives, special cases, examiner notes and diagrams. General marking pages and publisher pages are excluded.

cropMethod: PyMuPDF show_pdf_page clip to SVG with text as paths. Figure boxes snap to the drawing items wholly inside the caption region. Scheme page bounds cover all text spans, vector drawings and embedded images; breaks fall only in empty horizontal bands, preferring table rules and paragraph gaps; invisible white background fills are ignored when finding bands.
sourceNotes: The owner folder named "June 2022 papers" holds the Summer 2023 files; every file was identified by its cover, not its name.
9FM0/01 question paper (167,256 bytes) checked complete: cover 8 questions and 75 marks, page barcodes 1 to 28 in sequence, all 8 question totals present and summing to 75.

9FM0/02 Q5: the official mark scheme total line prints "(11 marks)" but its part marks (a) 2, (b) 2, (c)(i) 1, (c)(ii) 4 sum to 9, the question paper total. This is an official misprint: the question keeps 9 marks and the scheme is reproduced as published.
9MA0/31 mark scheme page 13 is wholly "Notes on Question 5" and is attached to Q5 after its main pages.
9MA0/32 mark scheme Q4 starts at the top of page 11 without a column header line; its pages were assigned by content.
9MA0/01 Q15: only Diagram 1 is reproduced; the "copy of Diagram 1" on page 42 is spare answer space. The wording "Using Diagram 1 on page 42" is kept verbatim.
9MA0/02 Q15: the two boxed passages are reproduced as bordered boxes, followed by the reprinted start of the proof.
mathsReview: Every question solved independently with SymPy and numeric checks (private scripts) and compared with the official scheme answers; no mathematical discrepancies; the only source error is the 9FM0/02 Q5 total-line misprint noted above.
